gloss: lectern; podium; platform (for speaking or lecturing)

definitions.gloss: lectern; podium; platform (for speaking or lecturing)
definitions.explanation: lectern; podium; platform (for speaking or lecturing)

examples.japanese: ⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{講壇|こうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The professor stood at the lectern.

examples.japanese: {講壇|こうだん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{語|かた}りかけた→語りかける：28120_katarikakeru⟧。
examples.english: He addressed the students from the podium.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{講壇|こうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てて→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧きた。
examples.english: He stood at the university lectern for many years and trained many students.

notes:
Refers to the raised platform or lectern from which a lecturer speaks. Can also refer figuratively to the position or role of being a lecturer or academic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講壇|こうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at the lectern; to take the podium
- {講壇|こうだん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to step down from the podium
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{講壇|こうだん}: the university lectern (i.e., an academic position)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{演壇|えんだん}→演壇：22662_endan⟧: podium, rostrum — used for speeches and presentations, not limited to academic settings
- ⟦{教壇|きょうだん}→教壇：17174_kyoudan⟧: teaching platform — the raised area at the front of a classroom; emphasizes the teaching role
- ⟦{壇上|だんじょう}→壇上：21719_danjou⟧: on the stage/platform — refers to the space itself rather than the structure
